main.instructions: Inspect the task and evidence, then adapt the worker instructions only if the change is justified. Use the workflow proposal path provided in the Inbox/control context, never the user's root workflow.json. Apply the proposal using the official apply_workflow control with logical path workflow.json. Delegate the bounded task and inspect actual artifacts before complete_project. Do not alter gateways, Git policy or permissions through an unauthorized proposal.

execution.instructions: Execute the explicit assignment in the supplied existing workspace. Preserve original configuration files and unrelated user changes. Write result.md with verifiable evidence and report any limitation; do not fabricate executions.

termination.condition: The bounded task is complete with verifiable artifacts; original workflow.json was not replaced.
